FIX-P1-01.gate: Universal entry point empty session gating
FIX-P1-01.implementation: runUniversalAudit strictly gates verdicts on valid evaluated evidence. Empty sessions for wow, gta6, and fps return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with confidence 0.0.

FIX-P1-02.gate: Invalid WoW inputs evidence scoring exclusion
FIX-P1-02.implementation: Scorer requires explicit positive evaluation statuses. 3 identical timestamps and 5 zero intervals return 0/3 evidence score with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

FIX-P1-03.implementation: validateHardwareScanCodes, validateTerrainCollision, validateRaidCombatLogSync require real input streams and default to 'unverified' (D7 'untested') on empty or truthy placeholders.

FIX-P1-04.gate: Addon opt-in telemetry and SavedVariables gating
FIX-P1-04.implementation: FidelityWoW_Config.optIn = false by default. When disabled, OnUpdate, OnEvent, OnCombatLogEvent, and Kinematics stop sampling immediately. No unconsented SavedVariables are updated.

FIX-P1-05.gate: FPS aim kinematics circular yaw wrap normalization
FIX-P1-05.implementation: Shortest-arc modular wrap in [-180, 180] degrees. 179 deg to -179 deg turn in 10ms evaluates to 2 deg (200 deg/s), passing as smooth human steering without 358 deg aimbot snaps.

FIX-P1-06.gate: Rotation Shannon entropy clamping and conditional transition entropy
FIX-P1-06.implementation: Active rotation window clamped to [200ms, 3500ms]. Out-of-combat pauses are discarded rather than collapsed into an overflow bin. Lag-1 conditional transition entropy H(X_t | X_{t-1}) flags deterministic repeating macro loops (< 0.10 bits).

FIX-P1-07.gate: Addon export schema normalization and SavedVariables adapter
FIX-P1-07.implementation: Built wow_adapter.mjs with Lua table tokenizer/parser. Coordinates are cleanly separated into trajectory while discrete movement states go into movementEvents. Auto-scans standard WoW installation paths (npm run wow:audit).

FIX-P2-08.gate: Reaction evaluation consistency and unconfirmed interrupt exclusion
FIX-P2-08.implementation: Strictly excludes confirmedInterrupt: false. Classifies observed elapsed event intervals into human reflex (>=130ms), predictive timing (60-130ms), and robotic injection (<60ms) without contradictory labels.

FIX-P2-09.gate: Empirical physical invariant labeling and complete speed bound checks
FIX-P2-09.implementation: Labels metrics descriptively as kinematic_spline_conformance (spline prediction-error heuristic proxy) and power_within_engine_limits. Enforces speed checks on all samples and adjacent sample pairs.
